value.name: mickey o'keefe advises micky to let go
value.description: Mickey O'Keefe tells Micky to stop worrying and let go, suggesting he does not need the current situation.
evidence: It's none a my business, but I been goin' to meetin's, and they say let go and let Gahd. You don't need this shit, Micky.

value.name: mickey o'keefe urges leaving dicky behind
value.description: Mickey O'Keefe proposes that they leave Dicky behind and go without him.

value.name: micky declines to abandon dicky
value.description: Micky thanks Mickey O'Keefe but says he cannot leave because Dicky taught him everything and has always been in his corner.
evidence: thanks, Mick, but Dicky taught me everything, he's been in my cornah, ya know. I can't do it without 'im.

value.name: mickey o'keefe challenges micky's dependence
value.description: Mickey O'Keefe tells Micky that he is already acting independently of Dicky.
evidence: You're already doin' it without him.
